cohort: Pregnant women visiting a tertiary care hospital
finding: Infection in antenatal women negatively influenced the mode of delivery and the mean body weight of the neonates born to infected mothers were comparatively less.
mod_finding: The Lower segment Cesarean section (LSCS) rate in GBS positive women was 60% and in Candida Non albicans positive women was found to be 65.38%.
birth_weight: lower in neonates of infected mothers
